summary: Second-pass review confirms both prior blocking issues are resolved: ComponentPanel.tsx now calls t() for health slider labels (all three locale files carry the keys), and AppShell reads locale from useUiStore to switch between bg-[#FFFBEB] (ja-kids) and bg-[#F9FAFB] (standard). All 8 B-tasks are complete — isValidId('_') returns false, ARIA tab ids and aria-controls are linked, the 3-column advanced editor layout is in place, StateGraph and AppearancePanel use pure SVG with no external library, the ja-kids home variant matches wireframe #07 (large buttons, warm-yellow background, no mode toggle), locale coverage works via intentional fallbackLng, and build/tests both pass (0 TS errors, 19/19). Two non-blocking concerns remain: AppearancePanel borrows editor.stateGraph.reset for the UV zoom reset button (wrong namespace, correct text), and MaterialPanel select options use hardcoded English graphics terms that bypass t().

issues.description: Line 299 calls t('editor.stateGraph.reset') for the UV zoom reset button. The translation renders correctly ('↺ Reset' / '↺ リセット') but the key is in the wrong namespace. Future changes to the stateGraph section may break this silently. Fix: add editor.appearance.texture.uvReset to en.json and ja.json, omit from ja-kids.json (fallback covers it), and update the call site.

MaterialPanel and TexturePanel select options use hardcoded English strings not going through t(): UV, Triplanar (mapping type); Back, Front, None (culling); None, Alpha, Additive (blend mode). The Minecraft material names (entity_alphatest, entity, entity_emissive) are API identifiers and can remain. All affected options are behind mode==='advanced' gates. Fix: add locale keys for the display-label options (UV/Triplanar/Back/Front/None/Alpha/Additive) to all three locale files.
